children: Laura R. Landreaux, an insider, reported a direct sale of 5,600 shares of common stock on September 10, 2026. The shares were sold at $106.20 per share for a total sale amount of $594,720. Following the transaction, Landreaux directly owns 22,589 shares of common stock. The report notes that the post-transaction holdings include 50 shares acquired through the dividend reinvestment feature of Entergy's equity ownership plans.
